tasks.spec:
You are a read-only architecture analyst. No changes anywhere: write only ./report.md; no git, no MCP, no skills, no network.

CONTEXT: the Mott SMS booking pathway (v92, live) plus its gateway accumulated structure through months of incident-driven fixes. Tonight's live evidence exposed five failure classes: (1) THREE overlapping date interpreters (pathway extraction, LLM-intent layer, raw-text authority) with no precedence rule - the raw one silently overrode a correct extraction; (2) the clarify node n_date_conflict asks but cannot consume the answer - a fail-stay trap (patient answered 'Friday the 14th' three times, extraction captured it, node re-asked forever, zero webhook calls); (3) the recall greeting sent twice, 3s apart; (4) a filler sentence baked into ~20 node prompts ('One moment while I check the schedule for you.') plus a second variant ('Let me check that for you.') - measured as pure waste (arrives 0.3s before the real answer, costs an extra SMS); (5) patient-facing copy assembled from raw internal conflict-tuple fragments ('Did you mean next friday Friday the 7th or the 17th Monday the 17th?'). The owner's direction: the flow needs SIMPLIFICATION in how the tools get used - evaluate structure and generate options.

LOCKED RULINGS you must respect or explicitly flag as needing re-ruling: interpretation stays HYBRID (pathway extracts AND gateway re-interprets - owner ruling 2026-08-03); clarify-on-week-disagreement, ONE question max, then proceed; latency budget <=15s per answer, filler dies; clock times never stated without fresh slot data; Mott now, CVC-ready.

SOURCES (read-only): /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/pathway-v92.json (the live graph, 48 nodes); workG/gateway-contract/report.md and workG/v86-wiring-map/report.md in the same directory (existing wiring studies); DIFF-INVENTORY.md (change archaeology); SPEC-v91.md (current design intent); /home/ankit114/repos/gw-diag-snap/container/bland_gateway.py (the gateway code now in production).

WRITE ./report.md:
1. STRUCTURE INVENTORY - measured from the JSON, with counts: nodes by type/purpose; every webhook call site (which nodes call availability or other gateway endpoints); every site that interprets or transforms dates (pathway prompts, extraction configs, gateway functions); copy duplication (how many nodes repeat near-identical prompt blocks, incl. both filler variants); distinct routing paths from greeting to a slot offer (depth and branching); unreachable or vestigial nodes if any. Cite node ids.
2. FRICTION MAP - map each of the five measured failure classes onto the structural feature that causes it (e.g. 20x duplicated prompt blocks make every copy change a 20-edit change; three interpreters exist because extraction round-trips were historically unreliable).
3. SIMPLIFICATION OPTIONS - two or three NAMED options, each with: what structurally changes (be concrete: which nodes merge, which interpreter demotes to hint, where the single availability funnel lives); what the patient experiences differently; build effort (S/M/L with what must be rebuilt/re-validated); risk to live behavior; which locked rulings it touches - anything revisiting the HYBRID ruling must be marked ASK-ANKIT, never assumed. At least one option must keep every locked ruling intact.
4. RECOMMEND - one option, grounded in the inventory numbers and tonight's evidence, with IF-WRONG cost.
5. Machine line: exactly one 'OPTIONS=<n> RECOMMEND=<option-name>'.
Final message <=15 lines.
tasks.check: grep -qiE 'STRUCTURE INVENTORY' report.md || { echo 'FAIL: no inventory section'; exit 1; }; c=$(grep -cE 'n_[a-z_0-9]+' report.md); [ "$c" -ge 10 ] || { echo "FAIL: only $c node-id citations, need 10+"; exit 1; }; grep -qiE 'FRICTION MAP' report.md || { echo 'FAIL: no friction map'; exit 1; }; grep -qE 'OPTIONS=[2-9] RECOMMEND=[A-Za-z0-9_-]+' report.md || { echo 'FAIL: no OPTIONS/RECOMMEND machine line'; exit 1; }; grep -qi 'ASK-ANKIT\|keeps every locked ruling\|all locked rulings intact' report.md || { echo 'FAIL: ruling-impact labeling missing'; exit 1; }; echo "PASS: $(grep -m1 'OPTIONS=' report.md); $c node citations"
tasks.verified: A measured structural inventory of the live pathway (webhook sites, interpreter sites, copy duplication, routing depth), tonight's five failure classes mapped to their structural causes, and scored simplification options with ruling impacts labeled - the owner's simplification question answered with numbers, nothing changed.
